text:
lina (prod-designer): Quick sync on the routing editor preview UI. When there are many rules the preview looks dense and users often mistake the stacked fills for a progress meter. Thinking we should reduce visual weight and add clearer labels.
omar (frontend): Agreed. Two ideas: 1) slim the fills to 6px and keep a larger hit target via invisible padding; 2) show percent on the right of each row, not inside the bar.
clare (pm): Also customers are confused by the validation label 'Overlap'. Can we make it actionable? e.g. 'Overlap between "Canary" and "Default". Make targets exclusive or change priority.'
sam (engineer): From an implementation POV: invisible padding still needs to meet touch target of 44x44. If visual bar is 6px tall we should keep vertical padding 19px above and below to meet that.
accessibility-bot: :warning: Contrast scan: accent blue (#1E90FF) over white for 12px labels = 3.0:1. Fails AA. Recommend darkening to token 'accent-700' or using neutral-900 for small text.
lina (prod-designer): Good catch. I'll swap tokens in the comp. Also proposing a small 'i' icon next to each weight: hover shows formula and an example sample rate.
omar (frontend): For keyboard reorder, the focus ring disappears when the preview overlay is toggled on. The overlay is `pointer-events:none` but still catches focus outlines. Need to ensure focusable elements remain visible when overlay active.
clare (pm): Microcopy for preview header: current 'Simulate traffic' -> 'Preview simulated routing (est. req/min)'. Add tooltip: 'Relative weights affect sample distribution; toggle to show absolute samples.'
sam (engineer): Perf note: calculate display percents with a stable reducer: `const total = rules.reduce((acc, r) => acc + r.weight, 0); const pct = Math.round((r.weight / total) * 100);` Cache by rule id. Ensure rule ids persist across edits for memoization.
lina (prod-designer): UX tweak: change rule badge from just 'High' to 'Priority: High' for clarity in screenshots. Also move the drag handle 8px to the left of the label so text doesn't overlap on small widths.
accessibility-bot: :white_check_mark: Suggestion: require 4.5:1 for <14px and maintain minimum touch target of 44px. Add aria-live for validation errors to announce overlaps.
omar (frontend): I'll prototype the CSS vars: `--preview-bar-height: 6px; --preview-handle-hit: 44px; --preview-gap: 12px;` And update keyboard focus behavior in the same PR.
clare (pm): Can someone own the new validation strings? Proposed set: 
- Overlap: "Rule 'Canary' overlaps 'Default'. Make targets distinct or lower the priority"
- Unsupported target: "Target 'ap-south-5' not supported. Edit or remove."
- Preview stale: "Preview out of date. Run preview to validate changes."
sam (engineer): I'll review those strings for length and aria-readability. 30m pairing after standup works for me.
lina (prod-designer): I'll upload updated frames with token swaps and the info tooltip. Will also include alternative color swatches that meet contrast.
clare (pm): Great — please paste the new Figma link here when ready and ping me for a copy pass.
lina (prod-designer): Will do. Thanks team! :sparkles:
